resources.string: Aligned header actions, grouped dates and compact, equal-width shortcuts leave more space for anime. Quick filters appear when active; all options remain in Filters.
Background blur returns behind every shared overlay. Sheets stay sharp, and closing the last overlay restores a clear screen.
Readable season controls, larger posters and a scrolling toolbar give anime more room. A TV icon opens the season browser from Home.
Search fields match the surrounding surfaces. Switch thumbs follow dark and AMOLED themes, and backdrop blur clears without an extra fade after dismissal.
